metadata.summary: Ben Stokes starred again with bat and ball as Durham boosted their Rothesay County Championship promotion hopes with a crushing 338-run win at Derbyshire with a day to spare.
metadata.content: Former England captain Ben Stokes stars as Durham thump Derbyshire to lift Rothesay County Championship promotion hopes | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content Former England captain Ben Stokes stars as Durham thump Derbyshire to lift Rothesay County Championship promotion hopes Ex-England skipper Ben Stokes stars as Durham thump Derbyshire to lift Championship promotion hopes while Division One leaders Nottinghamshire wrapped up a 145-run win against Surrey; Warwickshire climb up to second Saturday 22 August 2026 21:07, UK Image: Ben Stokes starred again with bat and ball as Durham boosted their Rothesay County Championship promotion hopes Ben Stokes starred again with bat and ball as Durham boosted their Rothesay County Championship promotion hopes with a crushing 338-run win at Derbyshire with a day to spare. The former England captain followed up his half-century and two wickets in the first innings by making an unbeaten 66 before taking 5-17 as Derbyshire were skittled out for 84 while chasing an unlikely 423 for victory. After resuming their first innings on 127-6, trailing by 156, Derbyshire were all out for 156, with Durham's Matthew Potts finishing with 5-46. metadata.summary: Lisa Ashton and Fallon Sherrock shared the spoils at Events 17-18 of the PDC Women’s Series on Saturday, as the duo scooped a title each to reinforce their positions of second and third in the rankings respectively.
metadata.content: Fallon Sherrock sweeps aside Lisa Ashton 5-0 to claim her first Women's Series title of 2026 | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to content Fallon Sherrock sweeps aside Lisa Ashton 5-0 to claim her first Women's Series title of 2026 Fallon Sherrock denies Lisa Ashton a second title of the day at Leicester's Mattioli Arena with a rampant 5-0 win to scoop her first Women's Series title in over 16 months; Beau Greaves - absent from Saturday's action - remains on top of the rankings Saturday 22 August 2026 19:54, UK Image: Fallon Sherrock scooped her first Women's Series title in over 16 months Lisa Ashton and Fallon Sherrock shared the spoils at Events 17-18 of the PDC Women’s Series on Saturday, as the duo scooped a title each to reinforce their positions of second and third in the rankings respectively. Leicester's Mattioli Arena played host to a double-header of Women's Series action, with Ashton and Sherrock celebrating success in Event 17 and 18. Ashton stormed to the Event 17 crown, breezing to the last 16 with a trio of whitewash victories, before conceding just a solitary leg against Lauren Hall to reach the quarter-finals. metadata.summary: New Zealand outscored hosts South Africa ‌five tries to one to win ​the first Test 33-16 at Ellis Park on ​Saturday and go one-up ‌in the four-match series.

The Boks led 13-12 at half-time, but New Zealand took over in the second half to close it out and end South Africa's unbeaten streak. The All Blacks had ​been underdogs going into the first international of their eight-match tour ​but took full ⁠advantage of the ⁠home side's numerous handling errors and ill discipline ‌for a statement victory that ended a 12-match winning streak for ‌the Springboks and will rock the confidence of the world champions.
